description:
Diagnose why the model is (or was) infeasible. Runs structural checks against the live model state — bus capacity gaps, hourly supply/demand mismatch, disconnected components, time-axis misalignment, zero-availability renewables — and returns ranked findings with suggested fixes and view anchors.
ALWAYS call this immediately after any solve result with status='infeasible'. Also useful pre-solve to catch show-stoppers cheaply. Solver-agnostic.

scenario_id.description: Which scenario to read: a named scenario by its id (the uuid exactly as it was shown to you) or its name, or the string "base" for the Base Scenario (the as-built network — it has NO id of its own, so never pass a guessed id for it). Omit to use the current scenario. Omit to diagnose the current scenario.

name: diagnose_infeasibility
